case_name: Satish Chander Ahuja v Sneha Ahuja
text: In view of the foregoing discussions, we answer issue Nos. 1 and 2 in following manner:- (i) The definition of shared household given in Section 2(s) cannot be read to mean that shared household can only be that household which is household of the joint family of which husband is a member or in which husband of the aggrieved person has a share. (ii) The judgment of this Court in S.R. Batra Vs. Taruna Batra has not correctly interpreted Section 2(s) of Act, 2005 and the judgment does not lay down a correct law.
